第25章：你就是言安希，言安希就是你
“别走。”何浅晴突然伸手一把拉住她，“我还有事要问你。”
“我只知道这一点了，我是新来的，我真的什么都不知道……”
何浅晴憋着一肚子气，现在碰到一个人不仅不认识她，还什么都不清楚，她更加心烦意乱了。
“真是没用，这也不知道那也不知道。”
言安希无辜的笑着，只想赶紧离开。
这个女人来者不善啊！她还是先走为好，免得发生什么变故。
忽然响起一声鸣笛，言安希和何浅晴同时转头看过去，一辆黑色的宾利从不远处开过来，在两个人身边停下。
车窗缓缓降下，言安希仔细的看了好几眼，发现这个开宾利的男人，她也不认识。
倒是何浅晴有些惊讶的说道：“沈北城？”
“何浅晴大小姐，没有想到在这里遇见了。”沈北城一笑，“喲，这旁边的美女是谁？”
言安希赶紧往旁边挪了挪，尽量远离这两个人。
她今天出门，是不是应该要先看看黄历才对？这个看起来器宇不凡的男人，又是谁？
何浅晴白了言安希一眼：“我不认识。”
沈北城也就没在意：“那你在这里干什么？慕迟曜现在不在家，在公司开例会。你找错地方了吧？”
听到慕迟曜的名字，言安希心里一咯噔，又看了沈北城一眼。
听语气，好像这个叫沈北城的男人，和慕迟曜很熟？
何浅晴脸色微微有些尴尬，她把墨镜重新戴上，顿了顿，才傲然的回答道：“我不找他。”
沈北城眼里飞快的闪过一丝笑意，倒也没再说什么：“我只是碰巧路过而已。没什么事的话，我先走了。”
“我也该走了，”何浅晴推了推鼻梁上的墨镜，“再见。”
说完，她就踩着高跟鞋，径直上了她自己的车，扬长而去。
看着何浅晴走了，言安希眼睛一转，赶紧脚底抹油的想先走，却听见沈北城的声音传来：“言安希？”
她一愣，听到自己的名字，下意识的停下了脚步，回头看了一眼。
这一眼，正好看见沈北城略微有些得意的眼神：“果然是你，看来我没有猜错。”
言安希连忙否认，装傻充愣：“我听不懂你在说什么，还有，你……你刚刚在叫谁？”
“别装了，你就是言安希，言安希就是你。我刚刚叫你的名字，你第一反应就是回头看我。如果不是你自己的名字，你会这么敏感吗？”
言安希还想着怎么否认，沈北城又说道：“好了，我又不是刚刚的何浅晴大小姐，来找你的麻烦。上车吧，你要去哪，我送你。”
“我的车能载慕太太一程，简直是荣幸至极。”沈北城看着言安希，眼睛里满是笑意，“慕迟曜这次，欠我一个人情啊。”
“何浅晴一看就是来找你的麻烦，我帮你把她弄走了，难道不算是帮了你的忙吗？帮了你就等于帮了慕迟曜。他的人情……可不好赚，我算是占着便宜了。”

Chapter 25: You are Yan Anxi, Yan Anxi is you
"Don't leave." He Qianqing suddenly reached out and grabbed her, "I still have something to ask you."
"That's all I know. I'm new here. I really don't know anything..."
He Qianqing was holding back her anger. Now that she met someone who not only didn't recognize her, but also didn't know anything about her, she was even more upset.
"It's really useless. I don't know this or that."
Yan Anxi smiled innocently and just wanted to leave quickly.
This woman comes with bad intentions! It was better for her to leave first to avoid anything unexpected happening.
Suddenly a whistle sounded, and Yan Anxi and He Qianqing turned their heads to look over at the same time. A black Bentley drove up from not far away and stopped beside the two people.
The car window slowly lowered, Yan Anxi took a closer look several times, and found that she didn't recognize the man driving a Bentley.
However, He Qianqing was a little surprised and said: "Shen Beicheng?"
"Miss He Qianqing, I didn't expect to meet you here." Shen Beicheng smiled, "Hey, who is the beauty next to you?"
Yan Anxi quickly moved to the side, trying to stay away from these two people.
When she goes out today, shouldn't she check the almanac first? Who is this man who looks like an extraordinary person?
He Qianqing rolled her eyes at Yan An Xi: "I don't know him."
Shen Beicheng didn't pay attention: "Then what are you doing here? Mu Chi Yao is not at home now, having a regular meeting in the company. Are you looking in the wrong place?"
Hearing Mu Chi Yao's name, Yan Anxi's heart skipped a beat and glanced at Shen Beicheng again.
From the tone of voice, it seems that this man named Shen Beicheng is very familiar with Mu Chi Yao?
He Qianqing looked slightly embarrassed. She put her sunglasses back on, paused, and then replied proudly: "I'm not looking for him."
A smile flashed quickly in Shen Beicheng's eyes, but he didn't say anything else: "I just happened to pass by. If there's nothing else, I'll leave first."
"It's time for me to go," He Qianqing pushed up the sunglasses on her nose, "Goodbye."
After saying that, she stepped on her high heels, got into her car, and drove away.
Seeing He Qianqing leave, Yan Anxi rolled his eyes and hurriedly rubbed the soles of his feet to leave first, but heard Shen Beicheng's voice: "Yan Anxi?"
She was stunned. When she heard her name, she subconsciously stopped and looked back.
At this glance, I saw Shen Beicheng's slightly proud look: "It is indeed you. It seems that I guessed right."
Yan Anxi quickly denied it and pretended to be dumbfounded: "I don't understand what you are talking about. Also, you...who were you calling just now?"
"Stop pretending, you are Yan Anxi, and Yan Anxi is you. I just called your name, and your first reaction was to look back at me. If it wasn't your own name, would you be so sensitive?"
Yan Anxi was still thinking about how to deny it, when Shen Beicheng said again: "Okay, I'm not Miss He Qianqing just now, here to trouble you. Get in the car, I'll take you where you want to go."
"It's a great honor to be able to carry Mrs. Mu in my car." Shen Beicheng looked at Yan Anxi with a smile in his eyes, "Mu Chi Yao owes me a favor this time."
"He Qianqing is here to trouble you at first sight. I helped you get her away. Doesn't that count as helping you? Helping you means helping Mu Chi Yao. His favor... is not easy to earn, so I took advantage."
